original_fields.Title: Description linked employer-employee data LEED quarterly
original_fields.Content: Quarterly linked employer-employee data (LEED) provides statistics on filled jobs, job flows, worker flows, mean and median earnings for continuing jobs and new hires, and total earnings.

original_fields.Title: Access data in Aotearoa Data Explorer – LEED from Jun23 qtr
original_fields.Content:
Access data in Aotearoa Data Explorer 

Aotearoa Data Explorer – LEED quarterly provides this data.
How to use Aotearoa Data Explorer contains video tutorials and a user guide.
